target: Anclaje del ramal B del Camino de la Tierra Húmeda.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Desvío conocido de suelo saturado y agua naturalmente oscura. Debe sentirse como mala ruta sin convertirlo en pantano mágico.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape of Sendero de los Charcos Negros branching away from the main wetland route. Saturated dark soil holds a sequence of shallow naturally black-looking pools caused by depth, mud and reflected overcast sky. A narrow uncertain footpath threads between them and disappears into wetter ground. Sparse reeds and flattened grasses show difficult footing. The main route is safer and visible behind.
negative_constraints: No tar pits, oil, poison, glowing liquid or supernatural black water
No corpses, skeletons or monster signs
No invented bridge, ruins or buildings
No characters or creatures as focal subject
